about: C3 3rd owner: the critic's major 9 by real input, in phase c (no pressure). (1) A row of the wharf market's stalls at 50 km/h, W held: it must take real speed and cost the car (it cost nothing and the speed rose 47 to 59). (2) A traffic car with my car stopped 10 m before it, facing it: it must not wait for ever (it waited 7 s and more) - it backs off, sounds its horn and goes round. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/tail_obstacles.json --size 1440x900 (NOIR_PORT=5343)

steps.name: the critic's stall row: W held from z -140 at 50 km/h, south along the wharf market's stalls

steps.eval: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; window.__st = { min: 99, max: 0, dmg0: C.my.damage, n: 0 }; C.my.on('smash', (e) => { if (e.item.kind === 'stall') window.__st.n++; }); (function loop() { const s = C.my.speedAbs * 3.6; if (C.my.pos.z > -138 && C.my.pos.z < -95) { window.__st.min = Math.min(window.__st.min, s); window.__st.max = Math.max(window.__st.max, s); } if (!window.__stStop) requestAnimationFrame(loop); })(); return 1; })()

(window.__stStop = true, JSON.stringify({ stalls: window.__st.n, minKmh: +window.__st.min.toFixed(0), maxKmh: +window.__st.max.toFixed(0), damage: +(G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.my.damage - window.__st.dmg0).toFixed(2), z: +G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.my.pos.z.toFixed(0) }))

steps.label: a row of stalls takes real speed (under 32 km/h from 50 with W held)
and costs my car (more than 0.4 of a damage step)

steps.name: a traffic car facing me, my car stopped in its way: it backs off and goes round

steps.eval: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase, car = C.traffic.cars.find((c) => c.v.speedAbs > 3 && !c.river); window.__tc = car; const v = car.v, f = new N.THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(v.yaw), 0, -Math.sin(v.yaw)); C.my.place(v.pos.clone().addScaledVector(f, 10), v.yaw + Math.PI, 0); C.my.damage = 0; window.__tc0 = { s: car.pilot.s, x: v.pos.x, z: v.pos.z }; return JSON.stringify({ at: [v.pos.x.toFixed(0), v.pos.z.toFixed(0)], s: car.pilot.s.toFixed(1) }); })()

(() => { const car = window.__tc, C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; return JSON.stringify({ alive: C.traffic.cars.includes(car), s0: +window.__tc0.s.toFixed(1), s: +car.pilot.s.toFixed(1), d: +Math.hypot(car.v.pos.x - C.my.pos.x, car.v.pos.z - C.my.pos.z).toFixed(1), myDmg: +C.my.damage.toFixed(2) }); })()

steps.label: within 9 s it has gone on past me (or out of the street)
